findings.title: Make target not re-runnable with the default output path
findings.message: The default output directory is fixed, and the tool refuses to overwrite an existing directory. A second local `make numerical-conformance` therefore fails with 'output already exists' until the user deletes the directory by hand.
findings.suggestion: Remove the directory before running, e.g. `rm -rf "$(CONFORMANCE_OUTPUT)"` as the first recipe step, or use a timestamped default path.

findings.title: Verify conflates integrity with identity compatibility
findings.message: `conformance verify` is documented as an integrity-only check, but it calls `ReplayCases`. That function also requires the corpus and registry hashes to match the current executable. A bundle that is intact but was produced by another build is rejected with a misleading 'replay corpus/model identity differs' error. `repro verify` has the same coupling through `reproduction.Load`, which compares `RegistrySHA256`.
findings.suggestion: Have verify call only `evidencebundle.Verify` plus schema decoding. Keep the identity-match check in the replay path.

findings.title: Zero-value report emitted on early failure
findings.message: When `Run` fails before producing a report (output already exists, unknown case, cancelled context), `report` is a zero value. The code still prints it as JSON to stdout, so consumers see a misleading empty report with an empty status.
findings.suggestion: Write the report only when `report.Schema != ""`. Otherwise return the error alone.

findings.title: PATH lookup contradicts the explicit-path claim
findings.message: The flag is documented as 'no auto-discovery', but `exec.LookPath` resolves a bare name such as `ngspice` through PATH. The executed binary can then differ from what the user meant. Only the version output and a digest are checked, so an unintended binary reporting 47 would be accepted.
findings.suggestion: Require an explicit path: reject values without a path separator, or use `os.Stat` and `filepath.Abs` instead of `LookPath`.

findings.title: Download not restricted to HTTPS and not retried
findings.message: `--location` without `--proto` can follow a redirect to a non-HTTPS protocol. The SHA256 check blocks tampering, but a restricted protocol list is still cheap hardening. There is also no retry, so a transient SourceForge failure breaks the CI job.
